rate_limits.correction: Published and endpoint-specific; SmartThings documents numeric limits and X-RateLimit response headers.

description.correction: Requests use Bearer access tokens. PATs are short-lived tokens for testing or personal use; production integrations must obtain access tokens through OAuth 2.0 API Access Apps, rather than authenticate API calls directly with app credentials.

notes: Free API access remains available through Q3 2026, but SmartThings plans to phase it out beginning in October 2026 and introduce a $4.99/month individual plan plus commercial tiers. The auth details also give an outdated PAT location: current PATs are created at account.smartthings.com/tokens and normally expire after 24 hours.
